title: Short-interval parity hits for nested floor powers at window X^{1/3}
statement: There is X_0 such that for all X >= X_0, away from sqrt-resonant regions: (depth 1) every window of consecutive odd x of length (2/3) X^{1/3} at scale X contains x with floor(x^{3/2}) even (and one with it odd); (depth 2) every such window contains x with floor(x^{3/2}) odd and floor(floor(x^{3/2})^{3/2}) even, in a prescribed target interval of relative length ~1. Together with the positive backward freedom flow of the hug itinerary's OE/OOE blocks (+5 len/12 and +7 len/24 bits per block), these give C_L nonempty for every L: hug cylinders are realized at all depths.
mathematical_domain: Juggler descent-free flights / short-interval equidistribution of nested floor powers
tested_range: parity-run census at scales 2^20..2^40 (data/research/juggler/hug_cylinder_construction/summary.json): max constant-parity runs of floor(x^{3/2}) over odd x are 58..836, always below the (2/3)X^{1/3} working window (ratio falls 0.86 -> 0.12), though ABOVE the naive quadratic-crossing budget (2/3)X^{1/4} at 2^36 and 2^40 (754 > 341, 836 > 683); OE pullback survival is 0.50 with zero empty anchors at 7 scales; OOE two-stage pullback hits track the (8/27)/2 w^{-1/9} law at 0.69-0.92 of prediction at generic offsets, but die completely (0/3000) in the sqrt-resonant region at 2^36
notes: Depth 1 is discharged uniformly by J-hug-flow-window-depth-one (EXACT — HUMAN PROOF). The interval-iteration reading of depth 2 is CLOSED (juggler_hug_flow_depth_two): J-hug-flow-image-gap says consecutive odd x have image gap ≥ 3 floor(√x), larger than the whole second-stage working window (2/3)Y^{1/3}=(2/3)X^{1/2}, ratio → 9/2. V(I) is a 3√X-separated packing; the span ≍ X^{5/6} is not an interval of y. Depth 2 remains ACTIVE only as a possible sparse-set statement, not as interval ET.
